This looks like 2–3 thin strips of cooked bacon on a square plate. The plate is probably a side plate, about 20–22 cm across. The strips are roughly 12–15 cm long and 2 cm wide, and very thin. Cooked bacon weighs about 3–4 g per slice, so I count three pieces at roughly 4 g each, about 12 g in total. Bacon could also be turkey bacon or jerky, but the color and shape look like crisp bacon. There are also small traces of sauce on the plate, which are negligible.
